content:
**Fried Fog Crawler** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A piece of Fog Crawler Meat which has been fried, making it safer to eat and improving its nutritional value.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Raw Fog Crawler Meat | | Fried Fog Crawler (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after having picked up Raw Fog Crawler Meat for the first time.
